data_model: single Organism entity with reference-population parameters
spatial_model: one root coordinate frame, standard anatomical position
evidence_model: reference physiology texts, population survey data
uncertainty_model: population ranges, never a single true value
resolution_limit: one declared population; not any individual, and not an average of individuals

data_model: Region entities with containment to L2 and L3
functional_model: none - regions locate, they do not function
uncertainty_model: boundary ambiguity recorded per region pair
resolution_limit: region boundaries are conventions, not physical surfaces; adjacent regions share tissue

data_model: System entities; membership many-to-many with organs
spatial_model: none - systems are not spatially contiguous
functional_model: system-level function statements with EVC grades
resolution_limit: systems are functional groupings, not spatial objects; immune and endocrine systems are diffuse and the model says so

spatial_model: surface mesh per organ, one canonical pose
functional_model: organ-level function plus supply, drainage, innervation
uncertainty_model: geometry is one exemplar; inter-individual variation not represented at this level
resolution_limit: a single reference geometry; organ shape and volume vary by tens of percent between individuals

spatial_model: surface mesh where the structure has a discrete boundary; otherwise a labelled region within the parent
evidence_model: anatomical atlases, surgical and histological reference
uncertainty_model: structures without discrete boundaries flagged as region-labelled, not meshed
resolution_limit: many sub-organ divisions are gradients (renal cortex to medulla); the model marks these rather than drawing a false boundary

data_model: TissueType entities; an Organ references composition, not instances
spatial_model: none - tissue is a composition property at this level
functional_model: tissue-level mechanical, transport and metabolic properties
resolution_limit: composition only; the model states what tissue an organ contains, not where each portion of tissue is

data_model: CellPopulation entities: cell type, host tissue, abundance distribution
uncertainty_model: abundance as a distribution with its source population; never a point count
resolution_limit: population statistics only; no individual cell is located or instantiated

functional_model: cell-type function, its inputs and outputs
uncertainty_model: cell type versus cell state distinguished; ambiguous cases flagged
resolution_limit: one canonical exemplar per type; real cells vary continuously and type boundaries are contested upstream

functional_model: organelle function within its cell type
uncertainty_model: schematic geometry marked as schematic wherever displayed
resolution_limit: schematic; organelle morphology is dynamic and cell-state dependent, and this model shows one state

functional_model: mechanism steps as an ordered causal chain
evidence_model: primary molecular-biology literature, curated pathway databases
uncertainty_model: each step graded independently; the chain is only as strong as its weakest step
resolution_limit: one exemplar mechanism per phenomenon; mechanisms are cell-type-specific and condition-dependent, and alternatives are not enumerated

data_model: Process entities with rate parameters, state variables and conditions
functional_model: quantitative process specification, executable only when parameterized
evidence_model: primary literature with measurement conditions attached
uncertainty_model: every rate carries its measurement conditions; in-vitro origin is flagged
computational_cost: high when executed; medium as specification
resolution_limit: rate constants are condition-specific and predominantly in-vitro; transfer to living human tissue is an assumption, marked as one
